selection_rule: Take the first entry in locked index.json order excluding the four discussed regression seeds; resolve and hash-check its complete manifest/parts through ReplaySource; select zero-based frame indices floor((N-1)*p) for p=[0.2,0.4,0.6,0.8]. Selection fixed before generating candidates. No rules changes permitted from this set.
own_registered_knowledge_policy: ReplaySource permits static rules from own known registered deck, but never future opponent identities or hidden opponent hand.

rules.name: Alania's Pathmaker
rules.oracle_text: When this creature enters, exile the top card of your library. Until the end of your next turn, you may play that card.

rules.name: Blooming Blast
rules.oracle_text:
Gift a Treasure (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they create a Treasure token before its other effects. It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.")
Blooming Blast deals 2 damage to target creature. If the gift was promised, Blooming Blast also deals 3 damage to that creature's controller.

rules.name: Flamecache Gecko
rules.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, if an opponent lost life this turn, add {B}{R}.
{1}{R}, Discard a card: Draw a card.

rules.name: Frilled Sparkshooter
rules.oracle_text:
Reach, menace
This creature enters with a +1/+1 counter on it if an opponent lost life this turn.

rules.name: Hoarder's Overflow
rules.oracle_text:
When this enchantment enters and whenever you expend 4, put a stash counter on it. (You expend 4 as you spend your fourth total mana to cast spells during a turn.)
{1}{R}, Sacrifice this enchantment: Discard your hand, then draw cards equal to the number of stash counters on this enchantment.

rules.name: Quaketusk Boar
rules.oracle_text: Reach, trample, haste

rules.name: Rabid Gnaw
rules.oracle_text: Target creature you control gets +1/+0 until end of turn. Then it deals damage equal to its power to target creature you don't control.

rules.name: Reptilian Recruiter
rules.oracle_text:
Trample
When this creature enters, choose target creature. If that creature's power is 2 or less or if you control another Lizard, gain control of that creature until end of turn, untap it, and it gains haste until end of turn.

rules.name: Roughshod Duo
rules.oracle_text:
Trample
Whenever you expend 4, target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains trample until end of turn. (You expend 4 as you spend your fourth total mana to cast spells during a turn.)

rules.name: Sazacap's Brew
rules.oracle_text:
Gift a tapped Fish (You may promise an opponent a gift as you cast this spell. If you do, they create a tapped 1/1 blue Fish creature token before its other effects.)
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card.
Target player draws two cards. If the gift was promised, target creature you control gets +2/+0 until end of turn.

rules.name: Steampath Charger
rules.oracle_text:
Offspring {2} (You may pay an additional {2} as you cast this spell. If you do, when this creature enters, create a 1/1 token copy of it.)
When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to target player.

rules.name: Valley Flamecaller
rules.oracle_text: If a Lizard, Mouse, Otter, or Raccoon you control would deal damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage plus 1 instead.

rules.name: Dauntless Veteran
rules.oracle_text: Whenever this creature attacks, creatures you control get +1/+1 until end of turn.

rules.name: Hare Apparent
rules.oracle_text:
When this creature enters, create a number of 1/1 white Rabbit creature tokens equal to the number of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.
A deck can have any number of cards named Hare Apparent.
